t: ff.70 The sun: solution or death?
st: The death of summer, Oppenheimer and solar panels

sec.p: Since the autumn equinox is around the corner, let's sing one last hymn to summer and to the sun, which we'll be seeing less and less of in the coming months.
Our atmosphere is getting hotter precisely because of the sun, obviously. But can't we channel this cluster of fused atoms in a positive, fortissimo way?

sec.t: ff.70.3 Solar panels are the bomb!
sec.p: Today, though, rather than the possible comeback of nuclear, I'm keen to talk about the latest developments in solar!

Remember when we only had 100 texts a day? Today we have practically unlimited gigs. Energy could meet a similar fate. If manufacturing and transport get electrified, everything will cost much less (forget 🌟 ff.50.4 Consumers, but not of energy).
